entries.scope: Accessible presentation of public statistics and compatible profile import
entries.rationale: Generate language-marked HTML with semantic row and column headings from existing evidence, preserving counts, dates, privacy and historical Markdown replay.
readerPaths: Profile or Level-0 README -> method -> frozen evidence and reproduction
entries.navigationImpact: Existing method links retained; table name and semantic row/column navigation added.
entries.languageStrategy: German and English exports with explicit language boundaries
entries.platformAndExampleProof: 84 deterministic assertions; Bash and PowerShell render checks; Linux/macOS/Windows hosted CI and live GitHub DOM checks
entries.risk: Incompatible profile import or altered public/private numeric semantics; deploy backward-compatible import first, compare every table cell, preserve frozen sources.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Renderer, importer, GitHub sanitization or table contract changes
